record.question: AS per the DPCO-2013, the retail price of scheduled(price-controlled) formulation:
options: Can be increased by 5% every year
Can be increased by 10% every year
Cannot exceed the notified ceiling price set by NPPA
Cannot exceed a ceiling price increase of 15% per year
record.explanation: Answer C: Cannot exceed the notified ceiling price set by NPPA. Under the DPCO 2013, the retail price of a scheduled formulation must not exceed the ceiling price plus applicable local taxes, where applicable. The option “cannot exceed the notified ceiling price” is the closest available choice but omits this tax qualification. Source/context note: Printed option should qualify ceiling price by applicable local taxes. Reference: https://pharmaceuticals.gov.in/dpcos. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
